question: Estimate monthly LCD/LED light bulb sales in a UP district (Gorakhpur ~45 lakh).
idealClarificationQuestions: All LED bulbs + tube lights (excludes CFL/incandescent which are legacy)? Yes.
Both branded + unbranded (huge unorganized market)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × annual bulb-buying rate × replacement cycle.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian LED bulb annual market: ~80 crore units/year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Branded (Philips, Wipro, Bajaj, Crompton, Havells, Surya): ~40% = ~9 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Value: avg ₹40 per unit blended = ~₹9 Cr/month.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~6/year on average (incl. tube lights, fancy lights).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Branded (Philips, Wipro, Bajaj, Crompton, Havells, Surya)

calculationFlow: Indian LED bulb annual market: ~80 crore units/year.
- Branded (Philips, Wipro, Bajaj, Crompton, Havells, Surya): ~40% = ~9 lakh.
- Unbranded / regional: ~60% = ~13-14 lakh (huge unorganized market in UP).
Value: avg ₹40 per unit blended = ~₹9 Cr/month.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Value: avg ₹40 per unit blended = ~₹9 Cr/month.
